title: Nosocomial Outbreak Simulation
text: Simulate outbreak population 30 people, starting one infection. Containment strategy starts day 10 reducing transmission hazards 50%.
code: library(nososim) library(ggplot2)  set.seed(123) dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:20  timeline <- make_timeline(n = 30, dates = dates, admission_delay = 0:4, R = 2) initial <- data.frame(id = "ID_1", date_infection = dates[1])  outbreak <- make_outbreak(   timeline,   initial,   w = dpois(0:10, 2),   dates = dates,   intervention = function(present, date) {     E_t <- matrix(       0,       nrow(present),       nrow(present),       dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)     )     if (date >= dates[10]) {       E_t[,] <- 0.5     }     E_t   } )  autoplot(outbreak, aes(colour = I("#B8D8D3"), fill = I("#176B65")))

title: Simulate an outbreak — make_outbreak
code: dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:6 timeline <- make_timeline(10, dates, stay = 7,   attributes = list(  ward = c(A = 0.5, B = 0.5), group = c(patient = 0.8, staff = 0.2) ))  initial <- data.frame(id = "ID_1", date_infection = dates[1])  global_ipc <- function(present, date) {   E_t <- matrix(     0, nrow(present), nrow(present),     dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)   )   if (date >= dates[4]) E_t[,] <- 0.9   E_t }  staff_masking <- function(present, date) {   E_t <- matrix(     0, nrow(present), nrow(present),     dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)   )   E_t[present$group == "staff", ] <- 0.9   E_t }  A_to_B_IPC <- function(present, date) {   E_t <- matrix(     0, nrow(present), nrow(present),     dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)   )   E_t[present$ward == "A", present$ward == "B"] <- 0.9   E_t }  make_outbreak(timeline, initial, w = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.3),   dates, intervention = A_to_B_IPC ) #> <nososim_outbreak> #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   individuals simulation_days initial_cases secondary_cases total_cases #>         <int>           <int>         <int>           <int>       <int> #> 1          10               7             1               2           3 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: first_case <date>, last_case <date>
